title: CFM-Bench: A Unified Multi-Domain, Multi-Task Benchmark for Channel Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2607.14975v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Channel foundation models (CFMs) are commonly evaluated in model-specific pipelines that differ in data, radio configurations, partitions, adaptation procedures, task definitions, and metrics, preventing reproducible comparison across CFMs and against task-specific networks. We release CFM-Bench, a unified multi-domain, multi-task benchmark comprising 157,900 official single-frame examples from six domains spanning 3GPP statistical simulation, two ray-tracing pipelines, terrestrial and aerial measurements, and synchronized vehicular multimodal simulation. Source-specific interfaces preserve complex channel state information (CSI) and the physical metadata available in each domain while allowing documented model-specific preprocessing. To reduce spatio-temporal leakage, official partitions isolate complete trajectories, measurement sessions, flights, vehicle links, simulation realizations, or buffered spatial regions. translated_title: CFM-Bench：用于信道基础模型的统一多域、多任务基准
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.14975v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：信道基础模型（CFM）通常在特定于模型的流水线中进行评估，这些流水线在数据、无线电配置、分区、适应过程、任务定义和指标上各不相同，从而阻碍了跨CFM以及与任务特定网络的可重复比较。我们发布了CFM-Bench，这是一个统一的多域、多任务基准，包含来自六个域的157,900个官方单帧示例，涵盖3GPP统计仿真、两条光线追踪流水线、地面和空中测量，以及同步的车载多模态仿真。源特定接口保留了每个域中可用的复杂信道状态信息（CSI）和物理元数据，同时允许文档化的模型特定预处理。为减少时空泄漏，官方分区隔离了完整轨迹、测量会话、飞行、车辆链路、仿真实现或缓冲空间区域。CFM-Bench排除了...
tldr: 本文提出了CFM-Bench，一个统一的多域、多任务基准，通过标准化评估流程和隔离时空泄漏，解决了信道基础模型在不同流水线中难以可重复比较的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CFM-Bench, a unified multi-domain, multi-task benchmark that addresses the challenge of reproducible comparison of channel foundation models by standardizing evaluation pipelines and isolating spatio-temporal leakage.
